findings.summary: INFO (not counted): the en context note for this key, rewritten in d640d4d6fd, says 'Keep Radient and Settings in Latin'. Radient is a product name, but Settings is a UI label, localized in every supported locale's sidebar (ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.settings) and page title (ui.settings.page.title). This translation uses the localized label, as every shipped 'Sign in to Radient in Settings…' sentence does. Writing 'Settings' in Latin would name a place this locale's UI never shows. The defect is in the English sidecar, not in this value; a context-only fix ('Keep Radient in Latin; Settings is the page's own label') is recommended to the PR coder.

Out of this namespace and not counted: the ur speech keys (ui.common.errors.speech_sign_in_enable, ui.common.speech.control.recording_sign_in / speaking_sign_in) write 'ترتیبات میں Radient سائن ان کریں' without the postposition میں after Radient, unlike every other shipped Radient sign-in string. This value follows the majority form and is not changed to match them.
